decisions.statement: The two compared here are the verdict the addon recorded and a fresh reading of that item.
Every item carrying a record is ruled on rather than a sample.
A rule index is compared only where both sides name an ordered rule.
A disagreement is gathered by the item it is about rather than by the stack.
How much of what is held carries a record is counted from the records present and said in every run.
An item carrying no record is out of coverage, and is counted apart from every disagreement.
A bag the addon's run never resolves carries no record, so agreement is no sign about that bag.
A record is of the run that last resolved the slot, and a rule changed since then disagrees.
No claim the addon threads across its run is threaded here, so an item a claim placed may disagree.
A run finding nothing says the two agree rather than answering empty.
A run that found a disagreement answers a code other than zero, in either form.
What that code says is what was found rather than what shape the answer took.
A row says when its record was resolved, taking the newest over the stacks it gathers.
A record no run dated is counted apart, and no fresh reading is held against it.

definition: whether the verdict the addon recorded on an item is what a fresh reading reaches
